newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-WOOSNAM AND STRICKER COMPLETE MILLION DOLLAR FIELD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WOOSNAM AND STRICKER COMPLETE MILLION DOLLAR FIELD.

text.p: Welshman Ian Woosnam and American Steve Stricker were named on Tuesday to complete the 12-man field for the Million Dollar Challenge at Sun City between Nov 28-Dec 1.

Woosnam, who won the event in 1988, will be competing in the event for the sixth time. Currently lying second on the European tour Order of Merit, the 38-year-old is expected to represent Wales in the 1996 World Cup of Golf at Erinvale near Cape Town the previous week..

The 29-year-old Stricker, one of the longest hitters on the American tour, has also been selected, along with Phil Mickelson and Mark O'Meara, to represent the United States in the Alfred Dunhill Cup at St Andrews in October.

For the first time in the history of the event, the Million Dollar Challenge field includes the year's four major winners: Britain's Nick Faldo (U.S. Masters), and Americans Tom Lehman (British Open), Steve Jones (U.S. Open) and Mark Brooks (U.S. PGA).

Complete field: Mark Brooks (U.S.), Ernie Els (South Africa), Nick Faldo (England), Steve Jones (U.S.), Bernhard Langer (Germany), Tom Lehman (U.S.), Colin Montgomerie (Scotland), Mark O'Meara (U.S.), Corey Pavin (U.S.), Nick Price (Zimbabwe), Steve Stricker (U.S.), Ian Woosnam (Wales).
